what: Corpay sells corporate payment products: fuel cards for vehicle fleets, lodging payment for travelling workers, accounts payable automation, and cross-border payments and currency hedging for businesses.
customers: Fleet operators, trucking companies, corporate finance departments and small businesses making international payments.
money: accounts payable automation and cross-border payments
fuel cards and fleet payment management
hotel payment for crews and insurance housing
moat: Closed-loop payment networks where it controls both ends of the transaction and earns a margin on each, with spending controls customers build their processes around.
risks: Fuel prices affect fuel card revenue directly
Debt of about $11 billion from continuous acquisitions
Cross-border payment competition from banks and fintechs is intense
opportunities: Revenue grew about 14% last year with a 44% operating margin
Corporate payments and cross-border are growing far faster than the legacy fuel card business
Acquisitions have consistently been integrated at higher margins
watch: Organic revenue growth by segment, especially corporate payments.
